test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct alternative from the given options that correctly changes the form of narration in the given sentence.

The Headmistress said, "What a performance!"

options.text: The Headmistress exclaimed what a great performance.
The Headmistress praised what a great performance
The Headmistress exclaimed that it was a great performance.
The Headmistress said that what a performance

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary task is to convert the direct speech into indirect speech.
 
• In indirect speech, exclamatory sentences often use the word "exclaimed" followed by "that".
 
• The exclamatory phrase "What a performance!" is converted to "that it was a great performance".
 
• Option 3 correctly follows these rules and transforms the sentence appropriately.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The Headmistress exclaimed that it was a great performance.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The Headmistress exclaimed what a great performance." – This option is incorrect because it does not convert the exclamatory phrase appropriately.
 
• **Option 2:** "The Headmistress praised what a great performance" – This option is incorrect because it uses "praised" instead of "exclaimed" and does not change the sentence structure correctly.
 
• **Option 4:** "The Headmistress said that what a performance" – This option is incorrect because it does not convert the exclamatory phrase appropriately and is grammatically incorrect.
